"""Install the reviewer differential harness into a scratch clone.

The fixture prefix of each test file is taken from the HEAD clone, so the
same bytes run at base and head (the two prefixes are identical anyway;
this asserts it). Usage: python3 -I install_harness.py <head-clone> <target-clone>
"""
import hashlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

head, target = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
here = '/tmp/claude-1000/-home-tze-GitHub-syzygy/9297eba3-858b-4aca-a313-05ea0802ad02/scratchpad/lead/b62/reviewer'
src = 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src'


def prefix(root, name, end_marker_line):
    lines = open(f'{root}/{src}/{name}', encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
    return '\n'.join(lines[:end_marker_line]) + '\n'


# Fixture sections end before the first case table's banner.
BODY_END = 334   # line 335 is the '// ---' banner before OTHER_PATH
JUDG_END = 263   # line 264 is the '// ---' banner before HOME_CASES
for name, end in [('body-read-authority.test.ts', BODY_END), ('walkthrough-judgment.test.ts', JUDG_END)]:
    a = prefix(head, name, end)
    b = prefix(target, name, end)
    assert a == b, f'fixture prefix differs between head and target for {name}'
    print(name, 'prefix lines', end, 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(a.encode()).hexdigest())

body = prefix(head, 'body-read-authority.test.ts', BODY_END) + open(f'{here}/diff_body_tail.ts.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
judg = prefix(head, 'walkthrough-judgment.test.ts', JUDG_END) + open(f'{here}/diff_judgment_tail.ts.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
open(f'{target}/{src}/zz-reviewer-diff-body.test.ts', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(body)
open(f'{target}/{src}/zz-reviewer-diff-judgment.test.ts', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(judg)
shutil.copyfile(f'{here}/zz-reviewer-corpus.ts', f'{target}/{src}/zz-reviewer-corpus.ts')
for f in ['zz-reviewer-diff-body.test.ts', 'zz-reviewer-diff-judgment.test.ts', 'zz-reviewer-corpus.ts']:
    print(f, hashlib.sha256(open(f'{target}/{src}/{f}', 'rb').read()).hexdigest())
print(subprocess.run(['git', '-C', target, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())

"""Compare base vs head differential outputs and check them against a
prediction computed independently from the two former rules.

Usage: python3 -I compare_diff.py <base.jsonl> <head.jsonl>
"""
import collections
import json
import re
import sys

OLD_BODY = re.compile(r'^(agent|bot|machine|service|system|ci|pipeline|model)([:\s-]|$)|\b(claude|codex|gpt|copilot|llm)\b', re.I | re.A)
OLD_JUDG = re.compile(r'^(?:agent|bot|ci|system|daemon|service|pipeline|automation|model|claude|syzygy)(?:[\s:/-]|$)|(?:\[bot\]|-bot|-agent)$', re.I | re.A)


def human_name(v):
    return 0 < len(v) <= 200 and not re.search(r'[`*\n]', v)


def load(path):
    rows = {}
    for line in open(path, encoding='utf-8'):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        r = json.loads(line)
        key = (r['gate'], r['prose'], r['owner'], r['kind'], r['mode'])
        assert key not in rows, key
        rows[key] = r
    return rows


base, head = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
assert base.keys() == head.keys(), 'row populations differ'
print('rows', len(base))
transitions = collections.Counter()
by_prose = collections.Counter()
mispredicted = []
changed = 0
for key in sorted(base):
    b, h = base[key], head[key]
    gate, prose, owner, kind, mode = key
    bo = (b['state'], b['caseId'])
    ho = (h['state'], h['caseId'])
    if bo != ho:
        changed += 1
        bcase = (b['caseId'] or b['state']).split(':')[-1]
        hcase = (h['caseId'] or h['state']).split(':')[-1]
        transitions[(gate, mode, bcase, hcase)] += 1
        by_prose[(gate, prose)] += 1
    if prose == 'none':
        old = OLD_BODY if gate == 'body-read' else OLD_JUDG
        predicted_change = human_name(owner) and bool(OLD_BODY.search(owner) or OLD_JUDG.search(owner)) and not old.search(owner)
        if predicted_change != (bo != ho):
            mispredicted.append((key, bo, ho, predicted_change))
print('changed rows', changed)
for t, n in sorted(transitions.items()):
    print('  transition', t, n)
for p, n in sorted(by_prose.items()):
    print('  changed by prose', p, n)
admit_flip = sum(n for (g, m, bc, hc), n in transitions.items() if bc in ('valid', 'lawful'))
refuse_to_admit = sum(n for (g, m, bc, hc), n in transitions.items() if hc in ('valid', 'lawful'))
other = sum(n for (g, m, bc, hc), n in transitions.items() if hc != 'owner-non-human')
print('admitted->refused', admit_flip, 'refused->admitted', refuse_to_admit, 'changes not ending in owner-non-human', other)
print('prose=none rows checked against prediction', sum(1 for k in base if k[1] == 'none'), 'mispredicted', len(mispredicted))
for m in mispredicted[:10]:
    print('  MISPREDICTED', m)
# Outcome-state population summary
states = collections.Counter((k[0], k[4], base[k]['state']) for k in base)
for s, n in sorted(states.items()):
    print('  base state', s, n)
